posts.trend: Indian Wellness Trends 2026: Why Sleep and Recovery Deserve More Attention
posts.context: Urban 30-year-olds buy sleep trackers and magnesium gummies to treat fatigue caused by work.
posts.angle: Sleep was free at twenty; at thirty it requires three gadgets and a daily performance dashboard.
slides: Your smart ring gave your sleep a 62% performance score.

Magnesium glycinate at 10 PM.
Blue light glasses on.
No water after 8 PM.
Ortho pillow angled at 15 degrees.
You lie awake until 2 AM wondering why your recovery score is so low.
posts.caption: Somebody you know spent fifteen minutes analyzing their deep sleep chart this morning.
posts.rank_verdict: The landing explains the irony of sleep tracking instead of executing a new turn.
